additional_confirmed_bugs.title: Non-ASCII local mutation token causes HTTP500 instead of rejection

additional_confirmed_bugs.sink: secrets.compare_digest(str, str) raises TypeError for non-ASCII strings

additional_confirmed_bugs.fix: Compare UTF8-encoded supplied header bytes with ASCII-encoded secrets.token_urlsafe session token using compare_digest.
additional_confirmed_bugs.verification: Both malformed headers now return403 with expected detail and no running/listed campaign. All47 targeted tests pass locally; no claim of CI validation.
